blocks.content: Planning to appear for CUET UG 2027? Understanding eligibility criteria is the first step toward securing admission in top universities. While the National Testing Agency allows a broad range of students to appear, individual universities may impose additional conditions regarding subjects, minimum marks and course-specific qualifications.
CUET 2027 Eligibility Criteria: Quick Overview

rows: CBSE, ICSE, State Boards, NIOS and equivalent
No upper age limit by NTA

blocks.content: Who Can Apply for CUET 2027?

Students who have passed Class 12 from a recognized board and candidates appearing in their Class 12 examination in 2027 can apply for CUET UG 2027. The examination is open to students from CBSE, ICSE, State Boards, NIOS and other recognized educational boards.

items: Students who passed in previous years
CBSE, ICSE and State Board students

blocks.content: CUET 2027 Age Limit

NTA does not prescribe any upper age limit for appearing in CUET UG 2027. Candidates of any age can appear if they satisfy educational qualification requirements. However, some universities may apply additional course-specific rules.

blocks.alt: CUET 2027 age limit and eligibility requirements

blocks.content: Educational Qualification Required

Candidates must have passed or be appearing in Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognized board. Students awaiting results may also apply, subject to fulfilling admission requirements at the time of counseling and admission.
Minimum Marks Required for CUET 2027
The NTA does not specify a minimum percentage requirement to appear for CUET. However, universities may require specific marks depending on the course and category.
Subject Eligibility and CUET Subject Selection
Selecting the right CUET subjects is essential because universities map admissions to specific subject combinations. A high score may not help if the required subjects were not selected.

blocks.content: Can NIOS Students Apply for CUET 2027?
Yes. Students from NIOS are generally eligible to appear for CUET UG 2027 and can seek admission in participating universities, subject to course-specific requirements.
Can Previous-Year Students Apply?
Yes. Candidates who completed Class 12 in previous years can apply. There is no restriction on gap years or previous passing year unless imposed by a specific university.

items.question: Who is eligible for CUET 2027?
items.answer: Students who have passed or are appearing in Class 12 from a recognized board.

items.question: Is there an age limit for CUET 2027?
items.answer: No upper age limit is prescribed by NTA.

items.question: Can Class 12 appearing students apply?
items.answer: Yes, they can apply subject to meeting admission requirements later.

items.question: Can NIOS students apply?
items.answer: Yes, NIOS students are generally eligible.

items.question: Is there a minimum percentage required?
items.answer: CUET itself has no minimum percentage requirement; universities may set one.

items.question: Can I apply after a gap year?
How many times can I attempt CUET?
items.answer: There is currently no attempt limit.

items.question: Can I apply to multiple universities with one score?
items.answer: Yes, CUET scores can be used across participating universities.
